"SmolAgents: Build Lightweight AI Agents with Hugging Face | Simplifying AI Workflows"
Description:
Join me for an engaging live session where we dive into SmolAgents, a lightweight Python framework by Hugging Face that makes building AI agents a breeze! Discover how you can harness this framework to create efficient, interactive agents for various applications with minimal setup and maximum flexibility.
What You'll Learn:
Introduction to SmolAgents: What it is and why it’s awesome for lightweight AI solutions
Step-by-step guide to building AI agents using SmolAgents
